about: PLAN-rmcp-local-mcp LM2 (decision D57): one verdict per MCP tool whose contract command is not proxyCapable. executor = made to run on the hosted executor against the session config; in-memory = re-implemented against the granted config the executor holds; local = never served remotely, admitted only on basis caller-disk (it reads or writes the caller's own disk) or terminal (it needs one). commandChange names the LM10 change for executor and in-memory. COMMAND_METADATA mcpSurface carries the same kind, basis and reason; packages/cli/src/commands/mcp/__tests__/mcp-coverage.test.ts holds the two equal and refuses a missing tool.

backup check.reason: Restores one file with the repository credential, which the granted config carries.
backup check.commandChange: Read the credential from the session config.

backup immutability show.reason: Reads the delayed-deletion window from the account server with the session token.
backup immutability show.commandChange: Use the session token on the executor.

backup manifests.reason: Lists manifests from the account server with the session token.
backup manifests.commandChange: Use the session token on the executor.

backup reconcile.reason: Calls the account server with the session token to reset a stored-bytes ledger.
backup reconcile.commandChange: Use the session token on the executor.

backup repair.reason: Needs the backup:manage token and the repository credential, which the executor holds through the session grant.
backup repair.commandChange: Read the token and credential from the session config instead of the caller's disk.

backup retention.reason: Reads the retention policy from the account server with the session token.
backup retention.commandChange: Use the session token on the executor.

backup retention preview.reason: Reads the next sweep preview from the account server with the session token.
backup retention preview.commandChange: Use the session token on the executor.

backup strategy list.reason: Lists the backup strategies stored in the granted config.

backup strategy show.reason: Shows one backup strategy stored in the granted config.

backup toc-key sync.reason: Derives the listing key from the repository credential, which the granted config carries.
backup toc-key sync.commandChange: Read the credential from the session config.

backup undelete.reason: Cancels a delayed delete on the account server with the session token.
backup undelete.commandChange: Use the session token on the executor.

backup usage.reason: Calls the account server with the session token; nothing local is read.
backup usage.commandChange: Use the session token on the executor.

cluster kubeconfig.reason: Writes the kubeconfig to a 0600 file on the caller's own disk and prints that path.

cluster status.reason: Lists clusters, or shows one, from the granted config.

config access list.reason: Lists the access keys stored in the granted config.

config audit log.reason: Reads the audit log file on the caller's own disk.

config audit verify.reason: Verifies the hash chain of the audit log file on the caller's own disk.

config current.reason: Names the config file the caller's own install selects, with its file path and token file state.

config list.reason: Lists the config files on the caller's own disk; a session holds exactly one granted config.

config prune.reason: Sweeps stale entries from the session config; a config-plane write through the write-back path (WB1, WB4).
config prune.commandChange: Prune the request-scoped remote state and write it back.

config reconcile.reason: Queries every machine and writes the rebuilt runtime state into the session config through the write-back path (WB1, WB4).
config reconcile.commandChange: Write the state bucket through the request-scoped remote state.

config show.reason: Shows the granted config, redacted, from the copy the executor already holds.
config show.commandChange: Serve a redacted view of the session config.

credits.reason: Prints the bundled third-party credits, which the executor ships too.

feedback list.reason: Lists feedback reports from the account server with the session token.
feedback list.commandChange: Use the session token on the executor.

feedback report.reason: Sends a report to the account server with the session token; the recorded-command forms read the history of the executor that ran the commands.
feedback report.commandChange: Use the session token and the executor's own command history.

feedback show.reason: Shows one feedback report from the account server with the session token.
feedback show.commandChange: Use the session token on the executor.

legal.reason: Prints the bundled legal documents and reads the accepted terms from the account server with the session token.
legal.commandChange: Use the session token on the executor.

machine access show.reason: Shows the access keys bound to a machine, resolved from the granted config.

machine add.reason: Adds a machine to the session config; a config-plane write that rides the write-back path (PLAN-rmcp-writeback WB1, WB4) and keeps its knowledge gates.
machine add.commandChange: Write through the request-scoped remote state.

machine converge.reason: Restarts repo daemons with the env secrets the granted config carries.
machine converge.commandChange: Read the env secrets from the session config.

machine infra cert status.reason: Reports the certificate cache files under the caller's own config directory; the executor holds no such cache.

machine infra show.reason: Shows a machine's infrastructure block from the granted config.

machine list.reason: Lists the machines of the granted config the executor already holds.

machine provider add.reason: Adds a cloud provider to the session config; a config-plane write through the write-back path (WB1, WB4) that keeps its knowledge gates.
machine provider add.commandChange: Write through the request-scoped remote state.

machine provider list.reason: Lists the cloud providers of the granted config.

machine provider remove.reason: Removes a cloud provider from the session config; a config-plane write through the write-back path (WB1, WB4).
machine provider remove.commandChange: Write through the request-scoped remote state.

machine prune.reason: Judges images against the session config only, so it can run on the executor without reading other configs.
machine prune.commandChange: Scope --orphaned-repos and --prune-unknown to the session config.

machine remove.reason: Removes a machine from the session config; a config-plane write through the write-back path (WB1, WB4).
machine remove.commandChange: Write through the request-scoped remote state.

machine scan-keys.reason: Scans host keys from the executor, which is where later SSH connections come from, and writes knownHosts back through the write-back path (WB1, WB4).
machine scan-keys.commandChange: Write knownHosts through the request-scoped remote state.

repo replicate status.reason: Shows replica sets recorded in the granted config.

repo secret get.reason: Returns the digest of a secret held in the granted config, never the plaintext.

repo secret list.reason: Lists secret keys and modes from the granted config, never values.

server status.reason: Finds the server through the caller's own local install record.

version.reason: Reports the CLI build installed on the caller's own machine and its update channel.
